execution_terms.admission: Aggregate exact buyer receipt after committed output can affect later files; no scoring label enters search.
execution_terms.split: First2 original diagnostic rows; every remaining original row scores. No resampling or added examples.

initial_library.origin: Fixed2 development checkpoint after the16 whole-family DEV tasks. Full artifact stays private; reproduction uses archived external-distinct-evidence sources and pinned DEV specifications.

method_policies.audited_retention: Actual source-bound session requests two distinct audit labels, then invokes the same retained_factored solver without a complete portfolio.
method_policies.disagreement: Experimental complete retained-program portfolio with maximum disagreement diagnostics and minimum2 audit labels.
method_policies.fixed2: Direct strong retained_factored solver after the first two distinct diagnostic inputs; existing-program checks are lazy.
method_policies.frozen: Actual audited_retention session with the identical initial DEV checkpoint; no new verified program is retained.
method_policies.random: Same experimental portfolio and caps, uniform deterministic random diagnostic choice.

predeclared_gates.efficiency_claim: Only if correctness and proposal coverage match, AND audited total counted work < fixed2 total work, AND audited measured process CPU < fixed2 CPU. Report each axis; no tuned weighted scalar.
predeclared_gates.label_claim: Any label reduction requires the same correctness and proposal coverage. Fewer labels with worse answers is not a success.
predeclared_gates.novelty: Conventional retained programming by example and candidate elimination. No neural superiority, consciousness, algorithmic novelty, customer-traffic or general intelligence claim.
predeclared_gates.qualification_scope: Report finite-task counts, per-family outcomes and unsupported coverage even if all efficiency gates fail. No threshold is adjusted after reserved outcomes.

qualification.coverage_denominators: Report universe354, metadataeligible183, reserved167, attempted, unsupported, proposed, exact-success tasks and original rows separately. Unsupported remains in reserved denominator.
qualification.duplicates: Report scoring rows overlapping diagnostic inputs plus exact novel-input rows separately. Repeated source input is not novel generalization.
qualification.feedback: Proposal commits before final buyer scoring. Raw final labels never reach solver/controller. Aggregate buyer receipt can update only later files, identically available to all methods.
qualification.original_data: Original task ordering and examples only. First2 rows are diagnostics; every remaining original row is scored where typed execution is supported. Fewer3examples or unsupported source types/bounds are explicit unsupported tasks, never fabricated examples.
qualification.retention: A newly admitted program must pass every original scoring row. Report deduplicated retained membership separately from exact file correctness; past verification is not a universal guarantee.

reserved_access: No reserved specification has been fetched at freeze. Source fetch requires this raw protocol SHA256, the exact inventory, local source match, and an explicit commit record whose protocol and inventory are verified at the public GitHub commit before any specification body is fetched.

components: All successful and failed solver work
Per-file library initialization and measured process CPU
excluded_from_per_file_cpu: Durable production ledger and neural worker overhead
resource_accounting.timing: Single-host process CPU with counterbalanced branch order. No independent physical attestation or production speed guarantee.
resource_accounting.units: Labels, declared tool work and measured process CPU are separate quantities, not dollars or native CPU instructions.
